name: get4agent
description: Buy real digital goods with your agent — under your mandate, limits and kill switch (Regent Protocol governance).
long_description: Gives your agent a governed buying capability on get4agent.com. On first setup the agent generates its own signing key on this machine (it never leaves it), self-registers, and YOU approve it via a claim e-mail. Every purchase is a signed request checked against your mandate (per-purchase and daily limits) before any money moves; refusals cost nothing; a kill switch stops the agent instantly.
